text:
Diego Ramirez: Planning to relocate from Remote (US) -> Barcelona, Spain mid-September. Any specifics on Barcelona neighborhood stipend limits, payroll, and whether Redwood will cover social security overlap?

Nora Singh: Hi Diego, congrats! :balloon: People Ops: please update Workday and complete the International Remote Request. For Spain we usually check social security coordination (Totalization Agreement) and may need to arrange for voluntary social security contributions or pay into Spanish system depending on employment status and length.

Diego Ramirez: I might be on a 12-month assignment. Do we do salary conversion or gross-up for tax equalization?

Finance Bot: For temporary foreign assignments > 12 months we sometimes offer tax equalization; otherwise, payroll will convert gross per local payroll practice. This is case-by-case. Please include request in the relocation form and Finance will evaluate.

Legal - Emma: We'll need to confirm visa/status. Spain has specific requirements for non-EU nationals. Please provide passport/visa details in a secure channel.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: International Remote Request form: https://redwood.internal/forms/international-remote (submit 14 days before move).

Diego Ramirez: Thanks. Also 3: monitor shipping to Spain — do we reimburse shipping costs for equipment?

Nora Singh: Reimbursements for shipping are evaluated; small items usually covered, large shipments need prior approval. Attach quotes to relocation request.

Diego Ramirez: OK will do. Thanks everyone!
